name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The traffic director that sits in front of most websites on the internet, routing visitors to the right place and keeping sites fast under heavy load.
buyer: There isn't really a new buyer here; it's plumbing every web hosting company and enterprise already runs, not a product someone starts a business around today.
business_use_cases: A hosting provider runs it as the invisible backbone behind every customer site it sells.
A DevOps consultant charges to configure and harden it for a client's production servers.
An enterprise's internal platform team uses it to load-balance traffic across their own services.

money_ideas.idea: One-off or retainer DevOps consulting to configure and maintain it for clients

steal_this: Not really a weekend business idea; the realistic move is adding 'NGINX configuration and tuning' as a line item to an existing DevOps consulting offer.
